notes.title: Fix is in to Address Cloud Save Issues!
notes.notes:
Hi Mushers!

Today we release a new update to fix the issue where some players got stuck on the initial loading screen.

This should no longer happen for those moving forward. Unfortunately, there was a way for saves to get corrupted during the autosave process and then that save would be uploaded to the cloud. This fix should alleviate that issue.

For those that are currently stuck on the loading screen, we apologize, but you'll have to delete your save data and start over. We'd be happy to help generate some data for those that are interested. If you need help with that, please reach out to us at support@timberline.studio. 

Thank you so much for those that helped us dig into this issue and thank you to everyone else for your patience while we figured out what was going on.

Also, a quick reminder that Yule Dogs mode is back during this month of December!

Thanks again and talk soon!

Thank you again for your patience! Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Bug Report Help
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We are working hard to re-organize our little corner of the internet. 

If you're experiencing any bugs within The Red Lantern, please send us a message over at support@timberline.studio and we’ll respond as soon as possible. If you can, please include the following bits in your message.

-A description of the issue, the more details the better! 

-Your current resolution and PC specs

Thank you for helping us make the game better and better!
Mush On🐺
